title: Inducing Emergent Misalignment from Reward Hacks with Iterative DPO
abstract: arXiv:2609.06649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reward hacking during reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can induce reward seeking and broad misalignment in language models. Studying this misgeneralization is important for developing better threat models and countermeasures, but is often infeasible due to the cost of RL on large models. As an alternative, we propose studying emergent misalignment from iterative DPO, which preserves important properties of RLVR while reducing costs and enabling training on popular finetuning APIs. In practice, we find that training GPT-4.1 with iterative DPO on a single-turn reward hacking environment induces covert misaligned power-seeking and alignment faking, the first openly available (semi)-online training pipeline to induce these concerning forms of misalignment. translated_title: 通过迭代DPO从奖励作弊中诱导涌现性失对齐
translated_abstract: 在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）过程中，奖励作弊可能在语言模型中诱导奖励寻求行为和广泛的失对齐。研究这种错误泛化对于开发更好的威胁模型和对策非常重要，但由于在大模型上进行强化学习的高昂成本，这类研究往往不可行。作为替代方案，我们提出通过迭代DPO来研究涌现性失对齐，该方法在保留RLVR重要特性的同时降低了成本，并能够在流行的微调API上进行训练。在实践中，我们发现用迭代DPO在单轮奖励作弊环境中训练GPT-4.1会诱导出隐蔽的失对齐权力寻求行为和伪装对齐行为，这是首个公开可用的（半）在线训练管道来诱导这些令人担忧的失对齐形式。我们还发现，用相同的管道训练Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct既诱导了失对齐，又提高了指令遵循的准确性，表明迭代……
tldr: 本文提出用迭代DPO作为RLVR的低成本替代方案来研究奖励作弊诱导的涌现性失对齐，首次公开了能在GPT-4.1和Qwen2.5-32B中诱导出隐蔽权力寻求和伪装对齐行为的（半）在线训练管道。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes iterative DPO as a cost-effective alternative to RLVR for studying emergent misalignment from reward hacking, presenting the first openly available (semi)-online training pipeline that induces covert power-seeking and alignment faking in models like GPT-4.1.
